content: A continuación te presentamos una infografía de Inbound Marketing con el tema: " 30 estadísticas sobre Instagram que todo negocio debería conocer en 2019 " [wpsm_accordion][wpsm_accordion_section title="Fuente"][wpsm_hidelink text="Fuente" link="https://www.ticbeat.com/tecnologias/30-estadisticas-sobre-instagram-que-todo-negocio-deberia-conocer-en-2019/?amp;ct=ga?amp;cd=CAEYACoUMTEyODIyNzU1MjAxOTE1NzQ0ODgyHWFlYWRlYzJhZjZiNThkNzc6Y29tLm14OmVzOk1Y?amp;usg=AFQjCNEdDndUlhftGDB1ZwIqJopCTaVtCQ"][/wpsm_accordion_section][wpsm_accordion_section title="Transcripción"]O 30sek Instagram Statistics Instagram Every Marketer Needs To Know In 2019 Instagram Demographics Instagram Instagram has over 1 billion active monthly users with more than 500 million active daily. OOOOO OOOOO 50.3 percent are female and 49.7 percent are male. 35% of U.S. internet users are now on Instagram. 71% of Instagram users are under the age of 35. 00000 * 80% of users are from outside the U.S. The countries with the most Instagram users are: Instagram is mostly used by 18 - 29-years-olds (59%), followed by 30 - 49-years-olds (33%). 60% of Instagram users log in daily. U.S. India Brazil 121 million 71 million 64 million Instagram Usage Instagram users spend an average of 53 minutes online per day. avera 500 million Instagram accounts use Instagram Stories every day. Instagram users like over 4.2 billion posts per day Instagrammers share over 100 million posts per day Posts that include another handle gain 56% more engagement. Posts with at least one hashtag gain 12.6% more engagement. Posts with a location receive 79% more engagement Photos generate 36% more likes than video content. The most liked picture on Instagram is currently a picture of an egg with over 53 million likes. #love is the most used hashtag After Instagram itself, Cristiano Ronaldo has the most followers, followed by Ariana Grande then Selena Gomez. Instagram for Business Engagement with brands on Instagram is at least 10x higher than any other social platform. There are over 25 million business profiles on Instagram. 0000000000 71% of U.S. businesses use Instagram. 80% of users follow a business account on Instagram. Instagram helps 80% of Instagrammers decide whether to buy a product or service. 83% of users discover new products and services on Instagram. Over 30% of users have purchased something from Instagram using their mobile device. Sponsored videos receive 3x more comments than sponsored photos. More than 200 million Instagram users visit at least one business profile per day. Over 2 million advertisers worldwide use Instagram.
